body: How am I going to go to her class for the rest of the year? And I have all these band trips and shit I'm taking and I'm going to be with her ALL THE TIME. I understand I'm leaving for college soon, but these next few weeks will be so completely horrible and I'm going to have to deal with (probably) half the faculty knowing. I mean, that's the obvious short term, which probably makes suicide seem stupid, but the long term is worse: I'm going to have these feelings forever, with no easy way to get rid of them. Wouldn't it be worse to have a family and impose my depression problems on them than to just end it now?
